description: SIMULATED submerged contacts for the demo replay. DISPLAY ONLY: hand-authored scenario data, not produced by the detection pipeline. SC-1 carries a SCRIPTED assessment (score, level, factors, recommended unit) shown in the alert list and labelled SCRIPTED. Times are minutes after scenario_start; unc_km is the radius of the position uncertainty.

low_cost_sensors.name: Fluxgate magnetometer buoy MAG-1 (simulated)
low_cost_sensors.note: Low-cost moored buoy; detects the magnetic anomaly of a steel hull passing within ~1-2 km

low_cost_sensors.name: Fluxgate magnetometer buoy MAG-2 (simulated)
low_cost_sensors.note: Low-cost moored buoy on the CABLE-1 corridor; detects the magnetic anomaly of a steel hull within ~1-2 km

contacts.name: Submerged contact SC-1
contacts.classification: Probable submarine, quiet diesel-electric transit (submerged, no snorkel)
contacts.summary: Westbound at ~6 kn to the protected subsea cable, then stops on the seabed over it; no AIS and no correlated surface vessel

methods.name: Passive TDOA triangulation
methods.detail: The same narrowband tonal (blade-rate harmonic near 30 Hz) arrives at HYD-14, HYD-16 and HYD-3 at different times; the time differences fix the position. Uses the existing hydrophone network, no new hardware.

methods.name: Fibre-optic DAS on the existing cable
methods.detail: The telecom cable acts as a kilometres-long acoustic antenna; the track crossing is seen as a moving low-frequency disturbance along the fibre. Needs only an interrogator unit at the landing station.

methods.name: Magnetic anomaly (MAG-2)
methods.detail: A fluxgate magnetometer buoy on the corridor records a short anomaly as the steel hull passes, confirming a submerged object, not a biological or surface source.

contacts.assessment_note: SCRIPTED scenario assessment for the demo: score, level, factors and recommendation are hand-authored to follow the same points and level thresholds as config.yaml; they are not computed by the pipeline.

factors.label: Unidentified narrowband tonal
factors.detail: 07:10 UTC: HYD-16 picks up a steady tonal near 30 Hz (blade-rate harmonic) with no surface vessel in AIS within 15 km. [SIMULATED]

factors.label: Submerged position fix, no AIS vessel
factors.detail: 08:00 UTC: TDOA between HYD-16 and HYD-14 gives a fix ±4.5 km; no AIS track passes through the uncertainty area, so the source is not a known surface vessel. [SIMULATED]

factors.label: Heading for protected subsea cable
factors.detail: 09:00 UTC: third hydrophone (HYD-3) tightens the fix to ±2.5 km; course 285° at ~6 kn leads to CABLE-1, 13 km ahead. [SIMULATED]

factors.label: Stopped over the cable: fibre disturbance
factors.detail: 10:00 UTC: the contact stops at the CABLE-1 route; DAS on the cable records a localised low-frequency disturbance at the same position. [SIMULATED]

factors.label: Magnetic anomaly confirms steel hull
factors.detail: 10:00 UTC: magnetometer buoy MAG-2 on the corridor registers a hull-sized anomaly; four independent sensors now agree (±1.2 km, confidence 90%). Charlie (UNIT-3), on scene at MV SEA FALCON 21 km away, is re-tasked. [SIMULATED]

assessment.recommendation_note: Charlie (UNIT-3) is the nearest asset: on scene at MV SEA FALCON, 21 km away; re-tasked to SC-1. Alfa and Bravo are already committed.

contacts.name: Submerged contact SC-2
contacts.classification: Possible submarine or unmanned underwater vehicle, slow loiter near offshore gas infrastructure
contacts.summary: Slow approach (~3-5 kn) then loiter near the Istria/Midia production area

methods.name: Passive TDOA triangulation
methods.detail: A weak tonal near 50 Hz is picked up by HYD-17, HYD-13 and HYD-4; time differences of arrival give a position fix that tightens as the contact approaches.

methods.name: Magnetic anomaly (MAG-1)
methods.detail: The magnetometer buoy near the production cluster registers a repeated anomaly while the contact loiters, separating it from surface traffic.
